verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents one-click launch of prebuilt templates, described as pre-configured environments usable as-is or customized. Named templates include PyTorch (with Jupyter), TensorFlow and Stable Diffusion UIs, and the docs note these images are cached on hosts so they start quickly. The docs homepage also points to copyable PyTorch, vLLM and ComfyUI deployments. missing for 10: an explicitly named CUDA base template, explicit confirmation that vLLM and ComfyUI are one-click templates rather than example deployments, and independent hands-on corroboration of template launches.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch from pre-built ML templates (PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM, ComfyUI) instead of assembling an environment from scratch

citations.quote: Launch prebuilt or custom templates with one click.
These are pre-configured environments that you can use as-is, or you can tweak them to your own requirements.
PyTorch - Ready for deep learning with Jupyter; TensorFlow - ML development environment; Stable Diffusion - Image generation UIs
PyTorch, vLLM, ComfyUI, agents, and more. Real deployments you can copy.
Despite their large size you'll find they generally start quickly because they have been cached on many of the host machines.
